shell_commands: ls specs/hal-engine-*/spec.md | xargs -I {} sh -c 'echo "=== {} ==="; grep -l "ping\|socket.*close\|tool.*result" "{}"' | head -30
grep -r "answers a ping at once\|answers an invalid ping" specs/ || echo "not found in specs"
grep -n "answers a ping at once\|answers an invalid ping" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md

grep -n "it('answers a ping at once while a run is pending\|it('answers an invalid ping at once\|it('queues three messages sent in one tick\|it('hands the second run" src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts | grep -v "connection signal\|socket\|list_sessions"
grep -n "sends a tool entry\|forwards a tool result" specs/hal-engine-*/spec.md
grep -r "commits the thinking entry before\|answers a second user_message only after\|hands the run its connection signal" specs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "not found in specs"
grep -n "answers list_sessions with a session_list" specs/hal-engine-*/spec.md || grep -n "session_list and serialized dates" specs/hal-engine-*/spec.md
grep -n "client sends\|A client sends\|answers.*session_list\|Over the WebSocket" specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | head -10

git add example/full-config.ts specs/hal-engine-abandon-on-close/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-executor-throw/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: resolve eslint errors and update spec citations

- Remove duplicated validation check by extracting checkValidation helper
- Replace switch dispatch with lookup table for better polymorphism
- Update spec citations to correct test line numbers after refactoring
- Add missing spec citations for list_sessions tests
- Disable camelcase rule for protocol message type identifiers
- Simplify config comments to satisfy line-length requirements

Fixes eslint violations from previous implementation round.
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main 2>&1 | head -20
